title: Posting the Room Rate Retained on an Early Departure from Resort Lodging
content:
Where a Resort Lodging party has left before the departure date on the reservation and the room rate retained for the nights given up falls due, it is put onto that reservation's folio as one retained room rate entry for the amount over the nights it covers, and the reservation's outstanding folio balance rises by that amount. The household sees a single retained nights line on the folio carrying the amount and how many nights it was worked out over, and the folio balance on the reservation goes up by the same amount.

A party that leaves before the departure date on the reservation has not changed the reservation, so no change fee arises from the early departure.

## The act and how it is made

The act is the desk agent's own. The tool `post_early_departure_charge_bb461064` is unlocked and then called by the agent, with the figure the agent has worked out from the collective's published terms and the records passed in; the tool writes what it is given.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `lodging_id` | the reference number identifying the Resort Lodging reservation whose folio the retained amount is posted to, read from the reservation record the lodging reservation lookup returns |
| `retained_amount_usd` | the amount retained for the nights given up, in USD, as a decimal amount rounded to 2 decimal places; a value carrying more decimals is stored rounded to the cent |
| `nights_retained` | how many nights the retained amount was worked out over, given as a whole number of nights with no fractions and no unit text |

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence on success, carrying the reference number of the folio entry created, the amount in USD retained, the number of nights it was worked out over and the reservation's folio balance after the posting. Receiving that sentence, with a folio entry reference in it, is what indicates the entry has been written.
